name: American golden dock
desc: American golden dock (Rumex fueginus): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 1 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Rumex fueginus, known as American dock, golden dock, and Tierra del Fuego dock, is a flowering plant in the family Polygonaceae. Rumex fueginus was first formally named by Rodolfo Armando Phillipi.
